overview_description.description: Cerebrium offers a no-code analytics and AI platform alongside serverless infrastructure for deploying and scaling AI models. It enables businesses to connect multiple data sources, such as Shopify, Google Ads, and Zendesk, with no engineering effort required. Automatically, data is cleaned and visualized through prebuilt dashboards and customizable metrics. Simultaneously, its serverless GPU infrastructure supports real-time LLMs, agents, vision models, and voice applications, delivering low-latency performance, auto-scaling, multi-region deployment, and per-second billing. Use cases include real‑time AI commentators, voice bots, and training avatars for simulations. The platform streamlines both analytics and AI application deployment without requiring code or DevOps expertise.
